narration.text: Albert Einstein immigrated to the United States.
In 1933 Albert Einstein renounced his German citizenship.

The record of naturalization for Albert Einstein at the National Archives at Philadelphia includes a Certificate of Arrival, Declaration of Intention, Petition for Naturalization, and Oath of Allegiance.
The Declaration of Intention for Albert Einstein is from 15 January 1936.
A photograph of Albert Einstein is affixed to the Declaration of Intention.
Albert Einstein's Petition for Naturalization has petition number 4009, assigned by the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey, Trenton.
Albert Einstein was photographed receiving from Judge Phillip Forman his certificate of American citizenship.
